title: AI Engineer – 100% Remote
description:
We're looking for an experienced **AI Engineer** to join our fully remote team. If you've built production AI systems with LLMs, know your way around RAG architectures, and want to work on a product where AI is the core — not an afterthought — this role is for you.

**What you'll do**

* Design and build LLM\-powered features and AI agent pipelines — from prompt to production
* Extend and optimize our RAG / knowledge base system: chunking strategies, embedding models, vector search, hybrid retrieval (BM25 \+ semantic), and reranking
* Implement agentic workflows with tool use, multi\-step reasoning and structured outputs
* Build document\- and email\-processing pipelines that leverage LLMs for classification, extraction and summarization
* Integrate and manage LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) and AI SDKs across the stack
* Design evaluation frameworks and feedback loops to measure and continuously improve AI output quality
* Build and optimize agents for our growing template library
* Operate in an AI\-first development setup powered by Claude/Cursor

**Our techstack**

* Backend: TypeScript
* Frontend: Next.js, React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui
* AI: OpenAI \& Anthropic APIs, Vercel AI SDK, vector search, semantic reranking
* Database: We don't want to disclose this publicly at the moment

**What we're looking for**

* Hands\-on experience building production AI systems with LLMs — not just prototypes, but systems that run reliably at scale
* Deep familiarity with RAG architectures: chunking, embedding models, vector search, hybrid retrieval and reranking
* Experience with AI SDKs and frameworks (Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
* Proficiency in TypeScript
* Comfort with agentic systems: tool use, structured outputs and evaluation
* You actively think about cost, latency and quality trade\-offs and know how to optimize across all three

**About Us**


We are a German automation agency turned into a SaaS with our product hausverwalter.ai.


Most Germany property managers work with 5\-10 software tools daily. Our goal is to replace them all, while also building autonomous agents right into the software.


For a closer look at what we're building, check out our YouTube channel — heads up, it's in German.


The role is fully remote – though you're always welcome to drop by our office in Worms, Germany. You'll fit in well if you're after more than just the "freedom part" of remote work and are truly eager to roll up your sleeves and grow alongside us for the long haul.

**Salary**


$1000 \- $3000 per month before taxes. There will be room for growth and promotion in the years ahead

**What we offer**

* 100% remote work
* AI\-first mindset
* As many Codex/Claude/Cursor\-Subscriptions as you need
* Permanent employment\-contract in your country of residence through our partner Deel (Employer of Record)
* A software that our customers are genuinely excited about
* Modern tech stack – you'll work exclusively with cutting\-edge technologies
* Focus on building, instead of long meetings
* Job security: Everyone we bring on is meant to grow with us over the long term. Every hire is aimed at permanent employment.
* Strong pay \& career prospects: We'll continue growing and expanding in the years to come. To do that, we need more experts and/or leaders on board.
* Very flexible working hours
* The freedom (and responsibility) to design and implement your own features


If a long\-term remote position at a structured, growing company sounds like what you're after, we'd be glad to receive your application.

  

* 2\+ years Hands\-on experience building production AI systems with LLMs — not just prototypes, but systems that run reliably at scale
* Deep familiarity with RAG architectures: chunking, embedding models, vector search, hybrid retrieval and reranking
* Experience with AI SDKs and frameworks (Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
* Solid English for async remote collaboration; German not required
* Technical understanding and strong problem\-solving skills
* You work autonomously and take full ownership of your tasks
* Comfortable working under performance pressure
* Quick on the uptake and a disciplined approach to your work


Please note that the application form on the next page is in German. That said, German language skills are not required for this role.

title: AI Prompt Engineer
description:
**About ClearGrid**
 ClearGrid is on a mission to
 **revolutionize the debt resolution industry** 
 . We’re using
 **AI, automation, and real\-time data** 
 to completely rethink how debt collection works, unlocking better outcomes for institutions and individuals alike. Think of us as rebuilding the collections —starting from scratch, with modern tools.
   

  

 We're a fast\-growing startup with ambitious goals, and we’re looking for builders who are hungry to make a real dent in a space with massive untapped potential.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a hands\-on, technical role that sits at the intersection of AI, language, and financial services. You will design and own AI agents that handle real customer conversations in Arabic and English, operating under strict compliance requirements set by our lender partners. The role demands equal parts linguistic precision, technical understanding of how LLMs work, and deep familiarity with financial services norms.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Agent Design \& Prompt Engineering**
* Write and own system instructions for AI voice agents end\-to\-end: persona definition, tone calibration, identity verification scripts, and dialect\-specific behaviour for Gulf Arabic audiences.
* Manage agents across the full customer contact lifecycle, from early\-stage reminder agents through to payment arrangement, broken promise, and compliance\-focused agents.
* Encode lender\-specific rules directly into system instructions.
* Inject dynamic customer and account variables provided by the data team to personalise each agent interaction.


**Daily Testing \& Quality Assurance**
* Run daily test calls to address a wide range of real\-world scenarios.
* Listen to live and recorded calls to identify bugs, off\-script responses, or compliance gaps, and ship hotfixes quickly.
* Work within a structured QA feedback loop, acting on review comments to improve agent quality before deployment.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to align on call triggers, variable feeds, and product rules.


**Voice \& Speech Optimisation**
* Develop new agent voices and evaluate them for naturalness, clarity, and suitability per lender and dialect.
* Tune STT/ASR (speech\-to\-text), TTS (text\-to\-speech), and latency parameters to maintain call quality.
* Control temperature and model parameters to keep agents within compliant, predictable behaviour, preventing hallucination and manipulation attempts.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Monitor developments in AI tooling, voice technology, and LLM capabilities and assess their relevance to the agent stack.
* Study real customer call dynamics alongside the operations team and use those insights to improve agent realism and effectiveness.
* Maintain detailed documentation for each prompt version across all client projects.


**Required**
**What We’re Looking For**
* Native or near\-native Arabic speakers.
* Demonstrated experience in AI prompt engineering or training AI/LLM models in a professional setting.
* Working knowledge of voice AI stack: STT/ASR, TTS, latency management, hallucination mitigation.
* Understanding of how LLMs think \- temperature, constraints, failure modes, and manipulation resistance.
* Experience or background in banking, debt collection, fintech, or financial services.
* Ability to produce structured, unambiguous written prompts in both English and Arabic.
* High attention to detail and comfort with repetitive testing and incremental iteration.


**Nice to Have**
* Hands\-on experience with voice cloning tools and multi\-voice agent pipelines.
* Familiarity with debt collection workflows: bucket segmentation, PTP cycles, RPC scripts, and lender compliance requirements.
* Prior exposure to Gulf\-based financial institutions or BNPL platforms.
* Experience coordinating with QA teams and managing structured feedback loops.

title: رئيس قسم الذكاء الاصطناعي - Head of Artificial Intelligence Section
description:
الهدف العام للوظيفة
 



 قيادة وتطوير استراتيجية الذكاء الاصطناعي في الوزارة، وتحمّل المسؤولية المؤسسية عن تحقيق القيمة المضافة من خلال توظيف أصول بيانات الوزارة ومنظومة الذكاء الاصطناعي بما يشمل تطبيقات الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي، وتحقيق الربط الفعّال بين التوجهات الاستراتيجية للوزارة وتقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي لقيادة مسيرة تبنّيه في مختلف قطاعاتها، وضمان توافق جميع المبادرات مع المعايير الأخلاقية ومتطلبات الحوكمة بما يعزز كفاءة اتخاذ القرار ويحقق أهداف التحول الذكي.
 



  





 المسؤوليات الرئيسية
 


* إعداد وقيادة استراتيجية الذكاء الاصطناعي للوزارة بما يتوافق مع أهدافها المؤسسية والوطنية، وتطوير نموذج التشغيل اللازم لتنفيذها وقياس أثرها في تحسين الكفاءة واتخاذ القرار.
* قيادة مبادرات التحول الذكي في الوزارة بما فيها تطبيقات الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي، واستثمار أصول البيانات المؤسسية لتحقيق قيمة مضافة قابلة للقياس.
* ضمان قابلية توسع نماذج الذكاء الاصطناعي وتكاملها مع سير العمل والأنظمة المؤسسية القائمة، مع ضمان جاهزية البيانات لمتطلبات الذكاء الاصطناعي.
* إنشاء وإدارة أطر حوكمة الذكاء الاصطناعي في الوزارة بما يشمل السياسات والمعايير ونماذج التشغيل، لضمان الاستخدام الأخلاقي والمسؤول وفق المعايير المحلية والدولية.
* تصميم وتطبيق إطار إدارة مخاطر الذكاء الاصطناعي بما يشمل تصنيف المخاطر وآليات التخفيف والمراقبة المستمرة لحماية الوزارة من الآثار السلبية المحتملة.
* الإشراف على تقييم واعتماد حالات استخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي وضمان امتثالها لمتطلبات الخصوصية وحماية البيانات والاشتراطات التنظيمية المعتمدة.
* التنسيق مع قيادات الوحدات والإدارات لتعزيز القدرات الذكية عبر الوزارة، وبناء ثقافة مؤسسية تثق في الذكاء الاصطناعي وتوظّفه بصورة فعّالة.
* التعاون مع الفرق التقنية لضمان أن البنية التحتية وعمليات تقنية المعلومات وهندسة البرمجيات وإدارة البيانات تدعم تشغيل حلول الذكاء الاصطناعي واستدامتها.
* متابعة أداء وأثر مبادرات الذكاء الاصطناعي وضمان تحقيق القيمة وفق مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية المعتمدة، وإعداد التقارير الدورية لقيادة الوزارة.
* تصميم وتنفيذ برامج التثقيف في الذكاء الاصطناعي وبناء القدرات التقنية لدى منسوبي الوزارة بما يضمن قدرتهم على التعامل مع أدواته وتطبيقاته بفاعلية.
* التواصل مع الجهات التنظيمية والشركاء الخارجيين والهيئات المعنية في شأن حوكمة الذكاء الاصطناعي واستراتيجيته.
* الإسهام في إعداد الخطط التشغيلية السنوية للقسم ومتابعة تنفيذها وضمان توافقها مع أولويات الوزارة الاستراتيجية.
* تنفيذ أي مهام أخرى يكلف بها مدير الإدارة في نطاق اختصاصه.



  





 المؤهلات والخبرة
 


* دكتوراه \- إحصاء / رياضيات تطبيقية / اقتصاد / علوم الحاسب / هندسة أو ما يعادلها (بدون خبرة)
* ماجستير \- الذكاء الاصطناعي / علوم البيانات / علوم الحاسب / هندسة أو ما يعادلها (3 سنوات)
* بكالوريوس \- علوم الحاسب / هندسة الحاسوب / هندسة البرمجيات / نظم المعلومات أو ما يعادلها (7 سنوات)



  





 الشهادات المهنية
 


* شهادة مهنية معتمدة في الذكاء الاصطناعي وتعلم الآلة مثل Google Professional ML Engineer / AWS ML Specialty / Azure AI Engineer Associate
* شهادة في الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي ونماذج اللغة الكبيرة مثل LLMs DeepLearning.AI Generative AI Specialization
* شهادة في حوكمة الذكاء الاصطناعي وأخلاقياته مثل IAPP AI Governance Professional / ISO 42001 Lead Implementer
* شهادة في علم البيانات وتحليل البيانات المتقدمة مثل IBM Data Science Professional / Databricks ML Associate
* شهادة في تشغيل نماذج الذكاء الاصطناعي وعملياته مثل MLflow MLOps Certified / Kubeflow Practitioner
* شهادة في إدارة المشاريع والتحول الرقمي أو ما يعادله ا PMP / PRINCE2 / SAFe
* شهادة في إدارة البيانات وهندستها أو ما يعادلها (CDMP)
* دورة في استراتيجية الذكاء الاصطناعي وتطبيقاته في القطاع الحكومي
* دورة في أخلاقيات الذكاء الاصطناعي والاستخدام المسؤول ومعالجة التحيز والشفافية
* دورة في قيادة التغيير وإدارة التحول المؤسسي باستخدام تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي
* دورة في هندسة الطلبات وتطبيقات النماذج اللغوية الكبيرة (Prompt Engineering)



  





  





  





  





  





**Job Purpose** 




 Lead and develop the Ministry's Artificial Intelligence (AI) strategy and assume enterprise\-wide responsibility for delivering measurable value through the effective utilization of the Ministry's data assets and AI ecosystem, including Generative AI applications. The role ensures the alignment of AI technologies with the Ministry's strategic objectives, drives AI adoption across all sectors, and ensures that all AI initiatives comply with ethical standards and governance requirements, thereby enhancing decision\-making efficiency and achieving the Ministry's smart transformation goals.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop and lead the Ministry's AI strategy in alignment with its organizational and national objectives, including designing the operating model required for implementation and measuring its impact on operational efficiency and decision\-making.
* Lead smart transformation initiatives across the Ministry, including Generative AI applications, while leveraging enterprise data assets to create measurable business value.
* Ensure AI models are scalable and seamlessly integrated with existing enterprise systems and business processes, while ensuring data readiness for AI implementation.
* Establish and manage the Ministry's AI governance framework, including policies, standards, and operating models, to ensure ethical and responsible AI usage in accordance with local and international standards.
* Design and implement an AI risk management framework, including risk classification, mitigation mechanisms, and continuous monitoring to protect the Ministry from potential adverse impacts.
* Oversee the evaluation and approval of AI use cases, ensuring compliance with privacy, data protection, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with business unit and departmental leaders to strengthen AI capabilities across the Ministry and foster an organizational culture that trusts and effectively utilizes AI.
* Collaborate with technical teams to ensure that IT infrastructure, software engineering practices, and data management capabilities support the deployment, operation, and sustainability of AI solutions.
* Monitor the performance and impact of AI initiatives, ensuring value realization against approved Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and prepare periodic reports for the Ministry's leadership.
* Design and implement AI awareness and capability\-building programs to enhance employees' technical skills and effective use of AI tools and applications.
* Liaise with regulatory authorities, external partners, and relevant organizations on AI governance, strategy, and compliance matters.
* Contribute to the preparation of the department's annual operational plans, monitor their implementation, and ensure alignment with the Ministry's strategic priorities.
* Perform any other duties assigned by the Department Director within the scope of the role.



**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* **PhD** 
 in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (no experience required).
* **Master's Degree** 
 in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (minimum 3 years of experience).
* **Bachelor's Degree** 
 in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (minimum 7 years of experience).



**Professional Certifications** 



* Professional certification in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, such as
 **Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer** 
 ,
 **AWS Machine Learning Specialty** 
 , or
 **Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate** 
 .
* Certification in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), such as the
 **DeepLearning.AI Generative AI Specialization** 
 .
* Certification in AI Governance and Ethics, such as
 **IAPP AI Governance Professional (AIGP)** 
 or
 **ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer** 
 .
* Certification in Data Science and Advanced Data Analytics, such as
 **IBM Data Science Professional Certificate** 
 or
 **Databricks Machine Learning Associate** 
 .
* Certification in AI Operations (MLOps), such as
 **MLflow MLOps Certified** 
 or
 **Kubeflow Practitioner** 
 .
* Certification in Project Management and Digital Transformation, such as
 **PMP** 
 ,
 **PRINCE2** 
 , or
 **SAFe** 
 .
* Certification in Data Management and Data Engineering, such as
 **Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP)** 
 .
* Training course in AI Strategy and its applications in the government sector.
* Training course in AI Ethics, Responsible AI, Bias Mitigation, and Transparency.
* Training course in Change Leadership and Enterprise Transformation using AI technologies.
* Training course in Prompt Engineering and Large Language Model (LLM) applications.

 Serve as an Artificial Intelligence (AI) expert within the Ministry's AI Department, responsible for ensuring the effective, ethical, and scalable deployment of AI systems across the Ministry's operations. **Key Responsibilities** 



* Define and oversee AI\-ready data requirements, including training datasets, operational input data, and decision models, while ensuring data quality, consistency, and integrity.

* Design and lead AI awareness and education programs for developers, end users, and stakeholders affected by AI implementations across the Ministry.
* Guide cross\-functional teams and coordinate multidisciplinary collaboration among solution development, engineering, operations, and business teams.
* Translate the technical capabilities and limitations of AI systems into practical recommendations and clear guidance to support informed decision\-making by management and stakeholders.
* Define and monitor AI model performance metrics, including accuracy rates, confidence scores, output acceptance rates, and model drift indicators, and prepare periodic performance reports.
* Manage feedback loops from AI users and operational teams to continuously improve AI models and business processes.
* Identify emerging AI use cases and recommend workflow and user interface enhancements to maximize organizational value.
* Support the enterprise\-wide scaling of AI applications by standardizing practices, developing reusable templates and tools, and documenting best practices to ensure consistency and efficiency.
* Address employee resistance and hesitation toward AI adoption by aligning AI solutions with team\-specific business needs, building trust, and promoting openness to accelerate the adoption of intelligent solutions.
* Build knowledge\-sharing networks and AI communities of practice across government entities, fostering collaboration and the exchange of best practices among AI professionals.
* Validate AI model outputs, identify edge cases and exceptional scenarios, and apply sound human judgment in complex decision\-making to ensure the reliability and accuracy of AI systems.

description:
Title: Senior Data Scientist
   

  

 Requisition ID: 5502
   

  

****OVERVIEW****
**Business Unit:** 
 President Complex
 **Department:**
 Group Chief Economist
   

  

****Division:****
 Statistics and Data Solutions
   

  

**Country:** 
 Saudi Arabia
 **Location:** 
 Jeddah, HQ
 **Job Grade:** 
 E3
 **Contract Type:** 
 Fixed Term
 **Closing Date:** 
 04\-Jul\-2026
   

  

****JOB PURPOSE****
 Undertake advanced statistical and data science work. This includes compiling, harmonizing, developing, and disseminating key statistical indicators and predictive models to support evidence\-based research and inform management decisions. Provide high\-quality, timely statistics and data\-driven insights that are crucial for guiding IsDB's operational strategies and enhancing country\-level dialogues. A core part of the role involves ensuring that the IsDB website is updated with the latest, high\-quality data and analytical insights on the bank's interventions and its member countries. Additionally, the role involves developing and maintaining robust, well\-governed databases and data pipelines, leveraging modern data technologies and advanced analytical methods, including machine learning, using platforms such as Microsoft Azure. It also promotes the adoption of innovative data techniques across the IsDB Group and its Member Countries, while coordinating with regional and international statistical agencies to align with global statistical standards and initiatives.
   

  

****KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES****
**Policy and Strategy Planning:**
* Contribute to the Division’s annual work plans, programs and activities.
* Contribute to the development and implementation of strategies, policies, procedures, and guidelines of the IsDB Institute.
* Contribute to the development and effective implementation of the relevant frameworks and tools for the Economic Work under the Economic Research and Statistics programs of the IsDB Institute.
* Contribute to the effective risk management and country, vulnerability, and debt sustainability assessments of IsDB member countries.


****Statistical Analysis:****
* Utilize advanced visualization tools and programming languages (e.g., Python, R, Tableau, Power BI, JavaScript, etc.) modern web technologies, and cloud\-based analytics tools to transform raw data into interactive dashboards and easy\-to\- understand graphical representations, including web\-based data applications and institutional analytical products.
* Develop and improve the aggregation techniques and methods to meet international standards and best practices including reproducible statistical workflows, automated indicator calculation pipelines, and documented methodological standards.
* Refine and optimize code to improve efficiency and ensure scalability, maintainability, security, and performance across data pipelines, APIs, dashboards, and analytical applications.
* Apply and deploy AI and Machine Learning techniques in data management, analysis, and quality control in Microsoft Azure , including Azure Data Lake, Azure Functions, App Service, and DevOps\-based deployment workflows.
* Design, deploy, and maintain scalable AI solutions, including machine learning models, internal chatbots, and AI\-enabled dashboards—to improve data access, automate validation, and support decision\-making across the IsDB Group.
* Proactively seek and identify new datasets that align with the IsDB Group's needs including official, third\-party, internal, and emerging data sources relevant to macroeconomic, development, and institutional analysis.
* Compile data from Member Countries and other relevant third\-party databases and official sources to produce appropriate data sets, key indicators, and aggregates for use by different departments across the IsDB Group including automated ingestion, transformation, and standardization of time\-series, country\-level, and institutional datasets.


****KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES****
* Develop appropriate mething and organizing relevant data, with special emphasis on the areas of macroeconomic analysis for sustainable development to support the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) and the development of centralized, governed institutional data repositories.
* Validate and ensure the credibility of the data compiled from the various official sources to ensure its accuracy, consistency, and comparability using automated quality checks, anomaly detection, reconciliation methods, and documented validation procedures.
* Maintain and monitor the databases to ensure their accuracy and functionality to minimize risks and interruptions in operations, including cloud\-based data storage, APIs, dashboard backends, and production data services.
* Timely response to the increasing demand for new and additional data sets to ensure efficient and effective decision\-making for the IsDB Group, including the development of secure data access services, dashboards, and self\-service analytical tools.
* Provide institutional support through statistical capacity development especially for the less developed countries to ensure capacity building for those countries.
* Contribute to the preparation of the data for the Bank’s Annual Report, Occasional and Research Papers, as well as dashboards, internal briefs, data platforms, and other institutional knowledge products.
* Design, develop, and maintain full\-stack analytical solutions that combine data science, front\-end dashboard development, backend APIs, and cloud deployment to support institutional data access and decision\-making.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of cloud\-based data architecture, including Azure Data Lake structures, curated data layers, API\-based data access, and scalable deployment patterns for institutional dashboards and applications.
* Develop and maintain secure, scalable, and reusable data services that enable controlled access to curated datasets for analysts, departments, dashboards, and institutional users.
* Support the modernization of the IsDB Group’s data ecosystem by translating business and analytical requirements into practical technical solutions across data engineering, analytics, visualization, AI, and cloud platforms.
* Performs other duties as may be assigned.


****Knowledge Sharing And Dissemination:****
* Guide and facilitate the knowledge transfer of the Division’s analyses and findings to other employees within the IsDB Group and externally to Regional Hubs to ensure awareness.
* Contribute to and coordinate the annual and periodic events conducted by the IsDB Institute, such as Seminars, Regional workshops, NGOs seminars and capacity\- building workshops.
* Participate in the preparation of statistical outputs and the Division’s publications and releases.
* Develop, participate in, and contribute to relevant internal and external training, conferences and other activities for advocacy, dissemination and knowledge building in member countries in collaboration with other regional and international organizations.
* Report IsDB operational data on the relevant Global Datasets and Global Reports.
* Organization of statistical events and statistical capacity development initiatives, including the OIC\-STATCOM, regional workshops, seminars, etc.


****Reporting:****
* Prepare periodic and thematic statistical reports and contribute to the preparation of relevant reports for the use and information of internal and external parties.
* Coordinate with other stakeholders to present the reports and publications related to performance of Division’s programs.


****Leadership And Mentoring:****
* Mentor data scientists, guiding them in complex data projects and fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and collaboration.


****Innovation And Strategic Contributions:****
* Lead and contribute to strategic projects that leverage innovative data science methods to drive decision\-making and policy formulation.


****ACADEMIC AND PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS****
* Bachelor’s degree in statistics, data science, programming, information management or related fields.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in advanced economic analysis focusing on economic and developmental issues, of which 3 years in an international development institution or national statistical office.
* Languages: English: Mandatory \| Arabic: Preferred \| French: Preferred


****SKILLS \& NECESSARY KNOWLEDGE****
* Advanced knowledge in descriptive, inferential, and advanced statistical applications.
* Ability to interpret and present statistical information in a user\-friendly manner.
* Data Collection and Management.
* Strong understanding of the national accounts, balance of payments and government fiscal accounts.
* Good macroeconomic understanding of the relationships between variables, both within and across accounting systems.
* Excellent knowledge of the principal sources and retrieval systems of economic and social development data.
* Proficient in appropriate statistical software packages such as STATA, R, PYTHON, Power BI, Tableau, JavaScript, etc.
* Advanced skills in collecting data, synthesizing data and maintaining databases.
* Advanced analytical thinking.
* Drive for Result.
* Accurate and methodical.
* Ability to work under pressure.

title: Senior Additive Manufacturing Engineer
description:
Some parts can no longer be machined into existence. You build them in metal or polymers, layer by layer, and qualify them to code.
 



  





 ATMTA is establishing a High Precision Training, Research, Development, and Production Center for the energy sector. We manufacture mission critical, precision engineered components for the oil and gas industry, built to perform under extreme pressure, temperature, and corrosion where failure is not an option, machined and tested to the highest precision and made intelligent with embedded sensing and AI.
 



  





 We are hiring a Senior Additive Manufacturing Engineer, on site in Muscat, to build the metal additive capability behind the next generation of oil and gas components.
 



  





 What you'll do: Own metal additive from process and metallurgy through to qualified production parts and repairs.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 


* Own metal additive in production, primarily on Metal systems and Polymer(directed energy deposition and powder bed), and equivalents such as Trumpf, EOS, or Meltio
* Develop and qualify additive processes and parameters for corrosion resistant and high strength alloys
* Apply additive to overlay, repair, and remanufacture of high value oil and gas components such as valves, wellheads, and downhole tools, and to near net shape and hybrid manufacturing combined with machining
* Qualify additive parts to API 20S (additively manufactured metallic components for the petroleum and natural gas industries) under API Q1, with construction and testing to ASME Section VIII and Section V as applicable, and sour service to NACE MR0175 (ISO 15156\)
* Control feedstock and process to the ISO ASTM 52900 series, with ASTM F3187 for directed energy deposition and ASTM F3055 for powder bed nickel alloys
* Control metallurgy, porosity, distortion, and residual stress, and validate with NDT and mechanical testing
* Develop apprentice additive specialists through structured on the job training, transferring process, metallurgy, and qualification practice
* Define competency milestones and qualify apprentices, building the center's own additive talent as part of its research and development mission



  





 What makes you a fit:
 


* You have taken metal and polymer additive into production or qualified parts, not only prototypes
* DMG MORI LASERTEC or EOS expertise is highly preferred; you know directed energy deposition, wire arc, or powder bed fusion deeply

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
**Role Highlights**

* Must be based in\-country and native level speaker of the country you're deploying to.


**The Mission of the Forward Deployed AI Engineer**
 In this role, you'll be the hands\-on AI builder defense and intelligence customers rely on. You’ll deploy ICEYE’s intelligence platform into secure (often air\-gapped) environments and rapidly ship AI\-powered workflows on top of it—everything from Docker\-based deployments to RAG systems fusing SAR imagery with intelligence reports. This is a ship\-code\-daily role: turning raw satellite data into mission\-critical tools analysts use to protect nations.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.
   

  

 ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.
   

  

 ICEYE\-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.
   

  

 Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia\-Pacific.
   

  

**Day To Day Responsibilities**
**Platform Deployment \& Integration**
* Deploy ICEYE's intelligence platform into customer secure environments (on\-premise, air\-gapped networks, classified data centers).
* Build and maintain containerized applications (Docker) and manage deployments in customer Kubernetes clusters.
* Develop APIs and data pipelines connecting ICEYE systems to customer C4ISR infrastructure and intelligence tools.
* Troubleshoot deployment issues in disconnected environments without external internet access.


**AI Solution Development \& Customization**
* Build Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems that combine ICEYE SAR data with customer intelligence documents for context\-aware analysis.
* Develop AI agents and workflows using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or similar tools to automate analytical tasks.
* Implement prompt engineering strategies and conversational AI interfaces that enable analysts to query satellite data using natural language.
* Create Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations connecting AI systems with customer data sources.


**Data Fusion \& Intelligence Workflows**
* Build data fusion pipelines combining SAR imagery with additional intelligence sources (AIS, RF signals, optical imagery, SIGINT).
* Develop automated workflows that correlate and cross\-reference information across different data modalities.
* Create lightweight tools, dashboards, and alerting systems tailored to customer operational needs.


**Customer Engagement \& Rapid Prototyping**
* Work embedded with intelligence analysts, data scientists, and military operators to understand mission\-critical problems.
* Rapidly prototype AI\-powered solutions (code first, polish later) that address immediate operational requirements.
* Conduct hands\-on training sessions on platform capabilities and AI workflow usage.
* Gather customer feedback and translate it into technical requirements for ICEYE's product and engineering teams.


 What we are looking for
   

  

**Must Have Skills**
* 3\+ years hands\-on software engineering building and deploying production systems.
* Strong Python programming skills (required) plus one of: Go, TypeScript, or Rust.
* Hands\-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and RAG systems.
* Working knowledge of agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, pydantic\-ai) and vector databases.
* Experience with Docker and deploying in secure / isolated / air\-gapped environments.
* Practical experience with APIs, data pipelines, and integrating systems in production,
* Familiarity with Linux and basic Kubernetes operations.
* Builder mindset: ship fast, iterate with feedback, and prioritize working solutions over perfect architecture.
* Strong communication \+ customer engagement, able to work embedded with intelligence analysts / military operators.
* Strong spoken and written English, able to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel 40–60% to customer sites within the region.


**Nice To Have Skills**
* Experience in defense, intelligence, or government operational environments.
* Deploying to on\-prem data centers and/or air\-gapped networks.
* Familiarity with geospatial data, satellite imagery, or remote sensing.
* Experience with MCP integrations, multi\-agent systems, or agentic workflows.
* Deeper Kubernetes, IaC (Terraform/Ansible), and/or offline CI/CD.
* Understanding of intelligence analysis workflows and defense/government requirements.
* Experience with data fusion, multi\-source intelligence integration, or GIS tools (ArcGIS, QGIS).
* Background in solution engineering, technical consulting, or customer success.
* Experience in defense tech (e.g., Palantir, Anduril, Scale AI, similar startups).


**Application process**
* Talent Acquisition Interview
* Take home task
* Hiring Manager Interview
* Hiring Team Interview
* Offer Decision


**Working at ICEYE**
 At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale\-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.
   

  

**How We Work (Our Values)**
**Make the impossible possible:** 
 We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.
   

  

* Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.
* See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.
* Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.
* Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.
* Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.


**Benefits**
 Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing—at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.
   

  

**Our commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**
 We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.
   

  

 We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.
   

  

 Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com

description:

 The company's sustained, accelerating momentum was recently validated by a $400M Series D financing round. Over the past three months, customers including Capital One, Lovable, Decagon, Polymarket, and Airwallex have adopted the platform or expanded existing deployments. These customers join an established base of AI innovators and global brands such as Meta, Cursor, Sony, and Tesla.
   

  

 We're on a mission to transform how companies use data. Come be a part of our journey!
   

  

**Join us in building the AI layer for Observability!**
 ClickStack is the open\-source observability platform we're building at ClickHouse — logs, metrics, traces, and session replays unified so engineers can find root causes quickly. The interesting work now is in the agent layer: systems that can investigate an incident at 2 AM, propose a root cause, and hand the on\-call a concise summary by the time they've logged in.
   

  

 We're hiring an AI Product Engineer to build agentic capabilities on top of a petabyte\-scale observability platform, with a focus on developer experience. If you've been building agents, designing skills, and wiring up MCP servers — and you've hit the limits of generic copilots for production work — we'd like to talk.
   

  

**What you'll do**
* **Build agents that investigate incidents.** 
 They surface anomalies, answer "why is production broken?", and use ClickStack as their substrate.
* **Write skills, not just prompts.** 
 Build a library of reusable skills that captures how our team debugs, finds root causes, writes ClickHouse queries, and runs incident response, so agents pick up the right playbook instead of starting from scratch.
* **Own the agent stack end\-to\-end.** 
 Context engineering, tool design, evals, tracing, cost. You're responsible for whether the agent works in production.
* **Make ClickStack a great place to run AI workloads.** 
 Build the MCP servers, SDKs, and integrations that let customers' agents read telemetry, take action, and stay observable themselves.

 Collaborate with OSS contributors and customers, debug their problems alongside them, and feed what you learn back into the product.

 Latency, cost, context window limits, eval coverage, hallucinations on real telemetry.

* Active in open source and the developer community.

title: Founding ML Engineer (Spectrum)
description:
Software engineers and AI agents alike suffer from the same problem: finding that one person or place that will answer their tough, specific question. Many solutions promise to solve this with similarity search in vector databases. Unfortunately, finding the answer is often a puzzle with pieces to be collected across a myriad of contradictory sources and cannot be solved without surgical search and careful reasoning.
   

  

 Spectrum collects data from an organization’s code, docs, and issues, and organizes knowledge in a unified ontology that AI agents can efficiently search through and reason over. We aim to revolutionize the semantic layer space for software\-building organizations and move beyond specs that fall out of sync with code, introducing a living spec – one that’s extracted from the whole system and used to keep it aligned. Spectrum is meant to be the single source of truth for all product and architectural knowledge.
   

  

 Spectrum is a resident of JetBrains' startup incubator, with startup speed and autonomy, and backed by 25 years of developer tooling expertise. We are looking for a top\-class ML Engineer who will help us shape the future of software development. You will own our AI and ML engineering stack and help define the research agenda for our team. Your technical vision and design decisions will directly shape the product and determine its success.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Include**
* Designing and building the ML/LLM solution for data ingestion, knowledge extraction, retrieval, and subsequent reasoning.
* Creating the datasets, metrics, and pipelines that drive measurable improvements across the system.
* Architecting and improving agents for context retrieval, knowledge extraction, and data alignment, which includes prompt engineering, model selection, and inference optimization.
* Establishing MLOps practices, including orchestration, observability, and experiment tracking.
* Collaborating with the engineering team on system design and with JetBrains Research on the research agenda.
* Defining hiring criteria, growing the ML team, and shaping the ML team culture.


**We Expect You To Have**
* A proven track record as an ML/AI Lead.
* At least five years of experience in ML/AI systems, with at least two years focused on LLMs and generative AI.
* A deep understanding of the LLM ecosystem, including model architectures and fine\-tuning approaches.
* Hands\-on experience with:
+ Prompt engineering and LLM pipeline design, including evaluation.
+ Agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangSmith, smolagents, or an equivalent.
+ Vector databases and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) patterns.
+ Deploying and scaling LLM\-powered applications using APIs (e.g. OpenAI or Anthropic) or open\-source models.

* Strong Python skills – Kotlin knowledge would be a plus.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Proficiency in English, both written and verbal.

* Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs, or graph\-based reasoning.

 **Projektsteuerer**

 Our software is running today on a
 **major autobahn construction program**

 **S\-Bahn transit program** 
 — multi\-year timelines, hundreds of thousands of pages of specs, protocols, and communications. Real consequences when we get it wrong.
 


  

 Tasks
   


**What you'd actually work on** 



  

  
* 1\. Agent harness engineering for construction documents
   

  

 One summary doesn't fit all. "Structural risk" in an RFI means something different than in a cost review, which means something different in a schedule reconciliation. We build multi\-agent harnesses — specialized extraction, reasoning, evaluation stages — that route 400\-page tender documents and protocol archives to the right pipeline with the right context.
   

  

 If you've read Anthropic's or LangChain's writing on agent harnesses and thought "yes, that's the hard part of shipping production agents" — that's this job.
  
* 2\. Project memory as a compounding moat
   

  

 We started with meeting transcripts. We're building a decision graph that grows with every project — tracking not just what was decided, but why, by whom, against which alternatives, and with what outcome. That graph feeds the next project. Every closed workflow makes the next one faster.
   

  

 This is the operational\-continuity layer no ConTech player is building. We want someone who gets excited that the hard part here is not retrieval — it's deciding what signal to keep.
  
* 3\. Context compression for 5 year projects
   

  

 What should the system remember? Forget? Surface at which decision point? There's no clean top\-k answer when a project spans 5 years and touches 50 stakeholders. This is an open research problem we're solving in production — and we'd rather hire someone who reads papers than someone who installs libraries.
  


  


**Stack:** 
 TypeScript, Next.js, Vercel, Supabase (Postgres \+ pgvector), LangChain, Vercel AI SDK, LangFuse, shadcn/ui.

 As one of our first hires, you’ll do more than contribute — you’ll help
 **shape** 
 how Alago works: our culture, systems, and growth strategy. You’ll work directly with the founders, gain exposure to every function, and ship projects that have immediate impact.

title: Deployed AI Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
   

  

 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
   

  

 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer\-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission\-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
   

  

**The role**
 Software only matters when it is actively being used and making a difference. As a Deployed AI Engineer, you will be at the heart of this \- taking state\-of\-the\-art software and integrating it into complex systems. You will be defining and executing against the end\-to\-end outcome and all steps on the way to delivering novel capabilities in some of the most challenging environments around.
   

  

 For example: you collaborate directly with customer avionics engineers to understand the data structures and APIs used in aircraft mission control systems. Instead of being scared, you embrace the complexity of unfamiliar databases, APIs, or network protocols; you dig into the specification and use your creativity and ingenuity to implement adapters for integrating them with Helsing’s cloud infrastructure. By working closely with our partners and customers (both metaphorically and quite literally), you continuously evolve, improve, and operate Helsing software. You own the outcome end\-to\-end.
   

  

**The day\-to\-day**
 In close collaboration with our product teams, you will discover and formalise customer requirements, identify bugs, and ship the latest features directly to our users. Technology demonstrations are our chance to shine \- you will coordinate between customers, partners, and Helsing engineers to showcase Helsing’s software and AI capabilities in simulations or with real systems.
   

  

**You should apply if you**
* Have a degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, or other relevant fields.
* Have a broad understanding and creative use of computer systems; this is the Swiss army knife in Helsing’s toolbox of world\-class talent.
* Prefer asking questions over stipulating answers.
* Love figuring things out, digging deeper and deeper into unfamiliar systems until it finally clicks, and you understand how they work.
* Are not afraid of legacy systems and would rather make them work than give up and try to rewrite it all.
* Are comfortable with scripting languages such as Bash or Python and have experience with software engineering in C\+\+, Java, Rust, or similar.
* Can navigate and configure Linux systems and have an understanding of network stacks and database systems.
* If applying for Germany\- it is a requirement that you are able to speak business level or fluent German


*Note: We operate at an intersection where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically* 
*under\-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.*
**Nice to have**
* Experience with Rust and Python.
* Experience with container\-based, cloud\-native and edge application architectures.
* Experience with maintaining and operating production systems using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or similar.
* Experience with SQL, NoSQL, and streaming database systems.
* Experience with production ML systems.
* Bonus points: you have professional experience working in a defence context.


**Join Helsing and work with world\-leading experts in their fields**
* Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns.
* The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world.
* Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward.
* In our domain, success is a matter of order\-of\-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts.
* We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about.


**What We Offer**

**Description**
**About osapiens**
 osapiens is building the operating system for sustainable enterprise: a single AI\-powered platform giving every company real\-time control over regulatory obligations, climate impact, supply\-chain risks, and physical assets. The ambition is not to be one more compliance tool, but the infrastructure every global enterprise runs on to operate responsibly in a world where sustainability is no longer optional.
   

  

 We reached unicorn status in January 2026 ($100M Series C from BlackRock/Temasek and Goldman Sachs), serve 2,500\+ enterprise customers and have delivered 10\+ consecutive quarters of 100%\+ ARR growth at 130%\+ net revenue retention. Four platform capabilities (Regulatory Compliance, Climate Intelligence, Supply Chain Transparency, and Asset Management) plus a network model that traces supply chains from origin to point of sale make the platform genuinely different. Not another point solution. The resilience control tower for the modern enterprise.
   

  

**The Role**
 Build osapiens’ GTM execution layer: the automated revenue engine that sits on top of the CRM, monitors external signals, and triggers the right play at the right moment. A technical revenue practitioner at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, and Operations, turning growth ideas into production systems in days. The role that used to take an SDR, a growth marketer, and a sales engineer combined, rebuilt around AI.
   

  

 Your Responsibilities
   

  

* The execution layer. Build and operate the automation on top of HubSpot that watches signals and fires the right play: scoring, enrichment, dedupe, routing, outreach, handoff. This is not CRM maintenance; it’s the engine on top of it.
* Scalable outbound systems. Replace manual prospecting with production systems that identify accounts, research contacts, and generate personalised outreach at scale. Precision, not volume.
* Dynamic data pipelines. Continuously enrich and segment leads, build live audiences off intent and behaviour, and keep the pipeline fed with the right accounts at the right moment.
* AI agents across the funnel. Design, build, and run agents for research, messaging, signal monitoring, AI BDRs, forecasting, and coaching. Models, tools, prompts, and data, all in production.
* Revenue\-system optimisation. Continuously improve conversion across the funnel (lead\-to\-meeting, meeting\-to\-opp, velocity) by changing what the system does, not by sending more email.
* Bridge Sales, Marketing, and RevOps. Turn any growth idea into reality fast. Remove the friction each function can’t remove itself.
* Tool evaluation and adoption. Stay ahead of the AI\-for\-GTM market: Clay, sequencers, AI BDRs, intent, CI, orchestration (Make, Zapier, n8n): Pilot, measure, adopt, deprecate.


 What success looks like (first 12 months)
   

  

* A live execution layer on top of HubSpot: signals monitored, scored, routed, and acted on end\-to\-end.
* A set of AI agents in production against real pipeline: research, messaging, and signals, at minimum.
* Measurable lifts on pipeline efficiency: time\-to\-first\-touch, reply rates, signal\-to\-meeting conversion \- traceable to shipped work.
* A public internal roadmap of AI\-GTM bets, ranked by impact, that other functions actually pull from.


 Your Experience
   

  

* 3–8 years in GTM Engineering, growth engineering, technical RevOps, or a revenue\-adjacent engineering role and a genuine passion for GTM.
* You can code (Python, JavaScript, SQL) and you ship. A portfolio of agents, automations, or production GTM workflows you’ve built end\-to\-end.
* Operator\-level fluency with the GTM stack. Clay first, plus HubSpot, Apollo, ZoomInfo, cold email infrastructure, LinkedIn automation, orchestration, and AI model APIs.
* Systems thinker. You see the revenue engine as a system, with inputs, loops, governance, and observability. You understand process, data, and application governance at scale.
* Data precision. You’d rather ship one play that converts at 8% than blast 10,000 emails at 0\.2%. Deliverability, signal quality, and enrichment are craft.
* Hybrid instinct. Equally comfortable with a sales rep, a growth marketer, and an ops lead. And you’re the one making all three faster.
* English fluent. German or Spanish a plus.


 How we work
   

  

* High energy, low ego. Go fast, learn, iterate, improve. Our competitors are not the benchmark — we want to be the winner in SaaS in how we do GTM Engineering.


 Join us for this and more...

* Room for creativity through collaborative teamwork and an open communication culture
* Flexibility and team bonding with our hybrid work options
* Fuel for your growth journey, both personally and professionally

title: Graduate software engineer
description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all\-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.
   

  

 In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent\-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.
   

  

 For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.
   

  

**A few examples of your responsibilities** 
* **Build software that matters.** 
 Take real ownership from idea to production, creating systems used by millions and evolving them into products at scale.
* **Amplify your impact with AI.** 
 Integrate the most powerful AI tools directly into your development workflow—design, implementation, testing, and documentation—to move faster while maintaining high standards for correctness, reliability, and maintainability.
* **Master your toolkit.** 
 Work across diverse stacks with end\-to\-end ownership, choosing the right technologies for each challenge. From monoliths to microservices, gRPC to REST, Kubernetes to Docker, Python to Rust—you’ll apply technologies thoughtfully, focusing on depth and purpose rather than trends.
* **Simplify relentlessly.** 
 Question every layer of complexity. Improve architectures, pipelines, and codebases to build systems that are simpler, more scalable, and easier to maintain.


**What we look for** 
* **Reasoning ability.** 
 Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
* **Drive.** 
 You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
* **Team spirit.** 
 You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
* **Proficiency in English.** 
 You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.


**What we offer** 
* **Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams.** 
 You’ll work in small, result\-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
* **An exceptional opportunity for growth.** 
 We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
* **Competitive pay and access to equity in the company.** 
 Typically, we offer individuals with limited experience an annual salary of £85,797 in London and €66,065 elsewhere in Europe. For a candidate that we assess as possessing considerable relevant experience, the salary on offer tends to be between £112,189 and £250,512 in London, and €107,837 and €188,848 elsewhere in Europe. Compensation varies by location and expected impact, and grows rapidly as you gain experience and translate it into greater contributions. For individuals who demonstrate exceptional capability, we may offer compensation that extends beyond the usual ranges to reflect their higher expected impact. If you're offered a permanent contract, you'll also be able receive some of your pay in company equity at a discounted price, thus participating in the value creation we achieve together. If relocating to Italy, you may enjoy a 50% tax cut.
* **All. These. Benefits.** 
 Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top\-of\-the\-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
* **A flexible start date and part\-time options.** 
 You don't need to wait until graduation to apply. We offer flexible start dates and the possibility to begin part\-time, transitioning to full\-time as you complete your degree. Many Spooners joined before graduating and progressively took on greater responsibility, with arrangements that allowed them to do so without compromising their education.


**Commitment \& contract**
 Permanent or fixed\-term. Full\-time.
   

  

**Location**
 Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.
   

  

**The selection process**
 In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.
   

  

 Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self\-reject.
   

  

 All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.
   

  

 We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.
   

  

 We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.
   

  

**Before you apply**
 If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.
   

  

 Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.
   

  

 To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long\-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.
   

  

 If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Wir entwickeln KI, die Ärztinnen und Ärzte während echter Sprechstunden nutzen. Sie ist bereits im klinischen Alltag im Einsatz, mit echten Nutzern und deutschen medizinischen Daten, kein Prototyp, der auf einen Launch wartet. Wir suchen eine starke Person, die direkt mit den beiden Gründern arbeitet und Verantwortung für die Modelle hinter dem Produkt trägt.
 



  





 Die Arbeit ist konkret. Du trainierst und feinjustierst (Fine\-Tuning) Sprachmodelle und ASR\-Modelle auf unseren eigenen deutschen klinischen Daten, baust und bereinigst die Datensätze dafür, richtest die Retrieval\-Schicht ein, die sie erdet, und misst, ob jede Änderung das Ergebnis wirklich verbessert. Was du baust, erreicht Ärztinnen und Ärzte innerhalb von Wochen.
 



  





 Wen wir wollen. Wir stellen nach belegbarer Leistung ein. Die kann von einer starken Universität kommen, einer ernsthaften Forschungsgruppe, einem angesehenen Unternehmen, aus Wettbewerbsergebnissen oder aus etwas, das du selbst gebaut und veröffentlicht hast und das wir uns ansehen können. Es zählt der Nachweis, dass du auf hohem Niveau arbeitest und zu Ende bringst, was du anfängst.
 



  





 Du solltest uns zeigen können:
 


* Solide Grundlagen in Machine Learning und NLP
* Echte Erfahrung im Fine\-Tuning von LLMs oder Spracherkennung (ASR), nicht nur im Aufrufen gehosteter APIs
* Retrieval\-Pipelines (RAG), die mit unsauberen Produktionsdaten standhalten
* Verlässliche Data\-Science\-Praxis: Daten aufbereiten, Datensätze bauen und bereinigen, ehrlich evaluieren und Ergebnisse lesen, ohne dich selbst zu täuschen
* Ein Modell vom Notebook zu etwas Verlässlichem in der Produktion bringen
* Sicheres Python und das aktuelle ML\-Werkzeug
* Die Fähigkeit, in einem sehr kleinen Team eigenständig zu arbeiten, viel selbst zu entscheiden und auf niemanden zu warten



  





 Sprache. Du musst Deutsch und Englisch sicher beherrschen. Unsere Datensätze und ein großer Teil der Fachdomäne sind auf Deutsch, deshalb ist das eine feste Voraussetzung, keine Präferenz.
 



  





 Ort und Modus. Hybrid. Überwiegend remote, mit regelmäßigen gemeinsamen Tagen in Wiesbaden.
 



  




* Bewerbung. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf oder dein Profil und ein paar ehrliche Absätze zu einem Modell, das du selbst trainiert oder feinjustiert hast: das Problem, was du ausprobiert hast und woran du gemerkt hast, dass es funktioniert. Diesen Teil lesen wir zuerst. Fehlt er, lesen wir den Rest nicht.

 Technical depth required. Architectural judgment expected.
   

  

 Salesforce is hiring Senior Forward Deployed Engineers — the Technical Builders, responsible for deciding that leads who design, build, and deploy the most complex agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll lead technical delivery on your team, mentor the next wave of engineers, and set the engineering standards that define how agentic AI gets deployed at scale.  r will drive the design, development, and productization of agentic AI capabilities within the Korro platform.  earning, platform engineering, or related technical roles.

title: Senior AI Researcher- Pre-training (f/m/d)
description:
**Our Mission**
 Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre\-training. Our customers — in finance, manufacturing, and public administration — need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high\-stakes settings. We’re building that in Heidelberg.
   

  

 We are hiring a Senior AI Researcher to join our Pre\-training team and to advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about designing inference\-efficient architectures, optimising training recipes that scale reliably, and training models on a large scale cluster (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you.
   

  

**Team Culture**
 We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organisational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision\-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **Senior AI Researcher in Pre\-training (f/m/d)** 
 , you will own the critical technical levers that determine the success of our next\-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling.
   

  

 Working at the high\-leverage intersection of research and engineering, you will translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions \- from small\-scale proxy experiments to multi\-thousand\-GPU runs.
   

  

 We are looking for an expert who can combine rigorous experimental design with high\-quality production code, directly influencing model quality, run reliability, and the efficiency of the models we ship.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Recipe \& Architecture Optimization: Own core elements of the training recipe (optimizers, schedules, initialization) and design PyTorch\-based architectural improvements to maximize convergence, stability, and training efficiency.
* Scaling Strategy \& Predictability: Develop hyperparameter scaling laws and scale\-up methodologies, using small\-scale proxy experiments to reliably predict multi\-thousand\-GPU behavior and de\-risk major training decisions.
* Stability, Diagnostics \& Debugging: Investigate complex convergence issues (loss spikes, divergence) and resolve hard\-to\-reproduce distributed system failures like communication bottlenecks, race conditions, and synchronization errors.
* System\-Model Co\-Design: Partner with Compute Performance, Data, Evaluation, and Post\-Training teams to align the model lifecycle with hardware constraints, memory bandwidth, and communication topologies.


**Core Qualifications**
* You are proficient in Python and deeply familiar with PyTorch\-based training workflows.
* You have a strong track record in machine learning research and software engineering, demonstrated through shipped models, impactful open\-source contributions, or published research.
* You have a strong mathematical foundation and are comfortable reasoning formally about optimisation, scaling behaviour, and training dynamics.
* You deeply understand transformer training dynamics, optimisation, and the behaviour of large distributed training jobs.
* You can design rigorous experiments, reason clearly from noisy results, and translate empirical observations into robust training decisions.
* Hands\-on experience pre\-training large models (e.g., 7B\+ parameters) on substantial infrastructure (e.g., 100\+ GPU clusters).
* You apply strong software engineering practices, including writing maintainable, well\-tested code and supporting reproducible experimentation workflows.
* You are able to implement complex model architectures efficiently and reliably and to debug complex issues across model code, training dynamics, and distributed systems.
* You collaborate effectively within a research and engineering team and communicate clearly about your work across Pre\-training and the broader AAR/AA organization.
* You are able to work in Germany and collaborate regularly on site in Heidelberg as part of the Pre\-training team.


**Preferred Qualifications**
***(We encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box!)***
* Large\-Scale Training: Hands\-on experience training LLMs or multimodal models on large GPU clusters using distributed frameworks (e.g., Megatron\-LM, DeepSpeed, torchtitan).
* Predictive Scaling: Familiarity with scaling laws, hyperparameter transfer, or methods for predicting large\-scale training behavior from smaller proxy runs.

title: System Platform Engineer KI (m/w/d)
description:

 Für unsere KI\-Plattform suchen wir KollegInnen in unterschiedlichen Erfahrungsstufen: Professional, Senior Professional und Principal System Platform Engineer
   

  

**Aufgaben**
* Als Platform Engineer arbeitest Du in Kombination aus Engineering\-Methoden und Cloud\-Architekturen mit den aktuellen Data\- und Analytics\-Technologien an der KI\-Plattform der R\+V.
* In einem Scrum\-Team entwickelst Du von der Spezifikation über Design, bis Implementierung unter Betrachtung von Skalierbarkeit und Stabilität unsere KI\-Lösung im ganzheitlichen Sinne von DevOps (You build it, you run it) weiter und betreibst diese.
* Du arbeitest intensiv mit CI/CD (GitLab), inkl. Builds, Tests, Security\-Scans, Deployments sowie Monitoring.
* Du definierst und setzt Proof of Concepts und Prototypen um.
* Auch Konzeption und Implementierung individueller Lösungen sind Teil Deiner Aufgabe.
* Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung bzw. Scouting von Technologien, Methoden und Tools sowie aktive Wissensvermittlung sind für Dich selbstverständlich.
* Die Vorteile einer engen Zusammenarbeit mit Data Scientists, Data Engineers und Fachbereichen nutzt Du für eine erfolgreiche Lösungsfindung.
* Du nutzt im Betrieb und Troubleshooting Containern Systeme wie Docker und bringst Erfahrung in der netzwerkseitigen Anbindung von Cloud\-Umgebungen an Unternehmensnetzwerke mit.
* Du möchtest Dich diesen Herausforderungen stellen, zusammen mit dem Team neue Wege beschreiten, Themen für die R\+V vorantreiben und Dich dabei persönlich weiterentwickeln.


**Profil / Anforderungen**
* Erfolgreiches Studium in Naturwissenschaften, Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
* Interesse daran, Dichin moderne Data\- und Cloud Technologien einzuarbeiten, insbesondere im Umfeld von Azure Machine Learning, Public Cloud, Data Factory/ Synapse Pipeline sowie Data Ingestion (ETL/ELT).
* Erfahrung im Erstellen und Debuggen von Docker\-Images sowie im Umgang mit Terraform und Python.
* Kenntnisse in Azure\-Infrastrukturen und \- Services, z.B. VNets, Service und Private Endpoints, Identity Management, RBAC/ACL sowie Azure Storage (insbesondere Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2\), sind von Vorteil.

* Du bringst eine Kommunikationsstärke, Teamfähigkeit und Freude in der Zusammenarbeit interdisziplinären Teams mit.
* Fließende Deutschkenntnisse (mind. Level B2\-C1\).


**Benefits**
**Homeoffice:** 
 Flexible Arbeitszeiten im Homeoffice und Büro. Mehr Infos zu unserem hybriden Arbeiten findest Du hier.
   

  

**Arbeitszeiten:** 
 Standardmäßig 38h\-Woche, Zeiterfassungssystem, Gleitzeit \& Lebensarbeitszeitkonto.
   

  

**Urlaub:** 
 30 Tage Urlaub \& zusätzliche arbeitsfreie Tage (24\.12\. und 31\.12\.).

 14 Monatsgehälter (inkl. Weihnachts\- \& Urlaubsgeld) oder Teilnahme am variablen Vergütungssystem, Sonderzahlungen, Mitarbeitertarife \& Rabattaktionen.

 Förderung \& Weiterentwicklung durch die R\+V Akademie. Die Übernahme externer Qualifizierungsmaßnahmen komplettiert Deine persönliche sowie fachliche Entwicklung.

Unser hauseigenes Fitnessstudio und ein breites Netzwerk von Sportangeboten (Wellpass) stehen Dir zudem online und bundesweit zur Verfügung. Zudem bieten wir für unsere Mitarbeitenden Betriebssportgruppen mit diversen Sparten an.

 Jobticket, Jobrad/Fahrradleasing, verkehrsgünstige Lage mit überdachten Fahrradparkplätzen sowie eine E\-Ladestation für PKW und Fahrräder.
   

  

**Familie \& Beruf:** 
 Eltern\-Kind\-Büro, Kindernotfallbetreuung, sowie Pflegenetzwerk \& Unterstützung durch die R\+V\-Sozialberatung.
   

  

**Kulinarik:** 
 Gesunde \& ausgewogene Speisen in unserem Betriebsrestaurant, dazu bieten wir täglich frisches Obst zur Selbstbedienung.

 Wir leben Gemeinschaft. Unser Motto „Was einer nicht schafft, schaffen viele“ spiegelt sich auch in unseren Teams und dem täglichen Miteinander wider.
